hook_styles: Name the character and the action in 3-7 English words (e.g. Tanjiro entered the Infinity Castle)
Big-IP cold open, specific not generic (e.g. Doctor Doom terrifies every Avenger)
One concrete scene fact (e.g. Haymitch was never the same)
A stake the picture already shows (e.g. She married her own assassin)
A short curiosity line from the shot (e.g. Nobody leaves the village after dark)

Doctor Doom terrifies every Avenger 💀 | Doctor Doom arrives | #edit
She married her own assassin 💀 | The wedding | #edit
caption_styles: Keep text inside top white bar short (3-7 words) with high readability font.
Use yellow/white bold lower-third subtitles synced precisely to speech or beat drops.
Add a simple interactive prompt in the pinned comment (e.g. Rate this edit 1-10).
Maintain high contrast text without covering key visual elements of the clip.

avoid: Low-energy tracks with no beat drop on obscure or romcom titles.
Repeating a topic or title, including a same-day duplicate.
The banned 'The reason why' hook or title, and Hinglish titles.
Forcing unique footage past ~24s. Aim 20-28s with a drop. Hard minimum stays 18s. Do not exceed about 32s.
Slow intro frames without visual motion or a readable English hook in the first 1.5s.
Cropping the frame, stretched vertical video, or heavy filters over faces.

our_insights: 13 Nov review of the 12 Nov 20:54 IST stats (12 videos, 20918 views, 3 subs). 06:30 Hollywood/big-IP action with a beat drop wins: Haymitch 10956 views (29s, 06:30, Godless, energy, drop ~12.6s) and Doctor Doom 2660 views (24s, 06:30, Adrenaline, energy, drop ~11s).

Low-energy tracks with no drop on obscure or romcom titles flopped: Maatrubhumi/Salman 3 views (31s, 22:30, Montagem Toma, energy false, no drop, Hinglish title) and Materialists/Lucy 5 views (33s, 17:30, teamo, energy false, no drop).

Do not repeat a topic or title. The same-day Godzilla Minus Zero duplicate got 43 views against 1229 for the original. Peddi still reached 1149 at 12:30 with Godless plus a drop even at 36s. Focker comedy reached 1123 at 17:30 without an energy edit.

English unique scene hooks only. Never the banned 'The reason why' template and never a Hinglish title. Raja Saab's Hinglish title still reached 958 with an energy edit, but the English big-IP hooks are the videos people actually watched.
Prefer about 24s (aim 20-28) with a music drop. Hard publish minimum stays 18s and the cap stays about 32s. The old 25s unique-shot floor wasted retries on cuts that already performed.
